title: Vatican confiscated the Fatima prophecy

tellings.quote: Vatican confiscated one of the prophecies from the the uh orphans or whatever that uh you know made the prophecy

plain: Michels says the Vatican seized one of the prophecies given in 1917 at Fatima, Portugal, by children he vaguely calls "the orphans or whatever". He mentions it in passing, citing a source called Secrets of Fatima, in an episode about a secret society and a final event. To him it suggests the Church kept back something it had been told.
